d: We are seeking an experienced AI Trainer to design and deliver high-quality training programs in Artificial Intelligence. The ideal candidate is passionate about teaching, possesses strong technical expertise in AI, and can translate complex concepts into practical, hands-on learning experiences. The trainer will prepare learners for real-world AI careers through project-based instruction and technical mentorship.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of professional experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
Experience delivering technical training, workshops, bootcamps, or mentoring.
Strong proficiency in Python and common AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or LangChain.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts to learners with different levels of experience.
Knowledge of vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus, or FAISS.
Experience with MLOps concepts and model deployment.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
r: Deliver instructor-led training in Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI.
Teach both foundational and advanced AI concepts through practical, project-based learning.
Guide trainees in building production-ready AI applications.
Evaluate learner performance and provide constructive technical feedback.
Support learners throughout their training journey and encourage continuous improvement.
Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices.

q: Proven experience in retail, ideally in luxury or high-end apparel.
Arabic Language is mandatory. Additional languages are a plus ( English )
Passion for fashion and an understanding of luxury customer service.
r: Interact with customers to understand their needs and interests Promote and sell products to customers
Keep track of inventory and restock products as needed
Manage and organize the store shelves and merchandise Help customers with product returns or exchanges
Meet sales goals and targets set by management Use technology and software to manage sales and inventory data.
